content.title: Tactile Travel Chapters | From Near Materials to an Elevated Overview
content.summary: Bind one traveler across at least four geographic chapters through stable identity, wardrobe and direction. Give every chapter one local material contact, expand spatial scale from constrained passage to social field to moving geography, then resolve through an ascent and a high wide hold under one archival-medium system.

quick_start.input_format: stable traveler identity, wardrobe and direction + at least four geographic chapters + one local material contact per chapter + constrained passage to social field to moving geography to elevated panorama + one coherent archival medium + high stable ending
quick_start.recommended_input: A 1970s volcanic-island botanist touches a field-station hatch, lifts one obsidian sample, grips a harbor rope as a survey boat passes, brushes a silver fern on a crater trail and reaches a high island-coast overlook.
required_anchors: Keep one traveler identity, wardrobe anchor and forward route direction across all chapters.
Give every location one brief physical contact with a local material or object.
Use one consistent archival-medium rule across all chapters.
Resolve the route through a climb and stable high-position hold.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Bind one traveler across at least four geographic chapters through stable identity, wardrobe and direction. Give every chapter one local material contact, expand spatial scale from constrained passage to social field to moving geography, then resolve through an ascent and a high wide hold under one archival-medium system.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Bind one original traveler through at least four geographically distinct chapters using stable identity, wardrobe and forward direction. In each chapter, require one brief hand, body or tool contact with a location-specific material before moving on. Order the chapters so spatial scale expands from constrained passage and near object, through a dense social field and moving background geography, to a final climb and elevated overview. Apply one consistent archival medium system across all locations. The reusable mechanism is tactile chapter binding, scale expansion and ascent payoff—not the source traveler, Istanbul, blue blouse, cream skirt, leather bag, wooden door, oranges, spice market, ferry, flower, stone stairs, skyline, exact film stock, camera path, creator identity or timing.

invariants.rule: Keep one traveler identity, wardrobe anchor and forward route direction across all chapters.
invariants.purpose: Makes separate locations read as one continuous memory journey.
invariants.ablation_failure: Identity or direction resets turn the piece into unrelated postcards.

invariants.rule: Give every location one brief physical contact with a local material or object.
invariants.purpose: Creates embodied evidence and chapter-specific memory anchors.
invariants.ablation_failure: Pure sightseeing produces generic scenic montage.

invariants.rule: Expand spatial scale from constrained passage through social and geographic breadth to an elevated overview.
invariants.purpose: Builds a readable progression rather than equal-weight clips.
invariants.ablation_failure: Random scale order removes the final destination payoff.

invariants.rule: Use one consistent archival-medium rule across all chapters.
invariants.purpose: Binds lighting and location changes into one remembered document.
invariants.ablation_failure: Changing defects or render media per cut fragments the archive.

invariants.rule: Resolve the route through a climb and stable high-position hold.
invariants.purpose: Turns movement into a destination with visible geographic understanding.
invariants.ablation_failure: Ending mid-route or on another close object leaves no culmination.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source woman's identity, hair, blue blouse, cream skirt, leather shoulder bag and exact gestures
the source Istanbul streets, wooden door, fruit and spice market, oranges, waterfront, ferry, flowers, stone stairs and skyline
the source route order, follow angles, light, exact early-1980s look, film defects and 30-second rhythm
the source visible people, signage, boats, urban layout and location-specific architecture
the source creator identity, Seedance 2.5 claim, platform overlay, watermark and branding
